title: Molecular dynamics and free energy analysis of curcumin binding near the DNA-recognition interface of NF-kappaB.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接、MD模拟和MM-PBSA分析小分子姜黄素与NF-kappaB p50 DNA识别界面的结合，虽非TF-DNA直接互作建模，但聚焦转录因子DNA识别区域并采用物理模拟方法，对本课题有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: Curcumin, a natural polyphenolic compound derived from Curcuma longa, is widely reported to modulate NF-kappaB signaling, primarily through indirect effects on upstream regulatory pathways. However, residue-level information on possible curcumin association near structurally relevant regions of NF-kappaB remains limited. Here, we investigated the predicted binding behavior of curcumin near the DNA-recognition region of the NF-kappaB p50 homodimer using molecular docking, 100 ns all-atom molecular dynamics simulation, and MM-PBSA free-energy analysis. Docking with the p50 homodimer model derived from PDB ID 1SVC identified a preferred pose near the Rel Homology Domain with an AutoDock Vina score of - 6.0 kcal/mol. Molecular dynamics simulations showed that the curcumin-bound model maintained persistent local contacts and exhibited reduced residue-level fluctuations near the predicted binding region. The complex showed a compact structural profile, with Radius of gyration (R(g)) values in the range of 2.50-2.60 nm, and lower solvent-accessible surface area relative to the apo model. MM-PBSA analysis indicated a favorable relative binding free energy dominated by van der Waals and electrostatic contributions. These findings provide a computational residue-level characterization of curcumin association near the NF-kappaB p50 DNA-recognition region.
abstract_zh: 姜黄素（curcumin）是一种源自姜黄（Curcuma longa）的天然多酚类化合物，广泛报道其通过间接作用于上游调控通路来调节NF-kappaB信号传导。然而，关于姜黄素在NF-kappaB结构相关区域附近可能结合的残基级信息仍然有限。在本研究中，我们利用分子对接（molecular docking）、100 ns全原子分子动力学模拟（all-atom molecular dynamics simulation）和MM-PBSA自由能分析，探讨了姜黄素在NF-kappaB p50同源二聚体DNA识别区域附近的预测结合行为。基于PDB ID 1SVC的p50同源二聚体模型进行对接，识别出一个位于Rel同源结构域附近的优选构象，AutoDock Vina评分为-6.0 kcal/mol。分子动力学模拟显示，姜黄素结合模型保持了持续的局部接触，并在预测结合区域附近表现出降低的残基级波动。该复合物呈现紧凑的结构特征，回转半径（Radius of gyration, R(g)）值在2.50-2.60 nm范围内，且相对于apo模型具有较低的溶剂可及表面积。MM-PBSA分析表明，相对结合自由能有利，主要由范德华力和静电贡献主导。这些发现提供了姜黄素在NF-kappaB p50 DNA识别区域附近结合的残基级计算表征。
